heading.title: Deductions to Be Made in Computing Total Income

article.title: Limit on deductions under sections 80C, 80CCC and 80CCD.
article.content: The aggregate amount of deductions under section 80C, section 80CCC and sub-section (1) of section 80CCD shall not, in any case, exceed one hundred and fifty thousand rupees.
article.html:
80CCELimit on deductions under sections 80C, 80CCC and 80CCD.

Section 80CCE · Chapter VIA · B.—Deductions in respect of certain payments · page 292 of the Act

The aggregate amount of deductions under section 80C, section 80CCC and sub-section (1) of section 80CCD shall not, in any case, exceed one hundred and fifty thousand rupees.
